verdict.rationale: LM Studio's chat interface and its new Bionic agent let users interact via natural language ('Talk to Bionic naturally' and 'work with Bionic to create and edit documents' for agentic tasks), which supports the story. However, hands-on community reports show mixed early results — MCP/agentic interactions getting stuck in loops and unclear agent state/controls — indicating the natural-language operation is still rough at the edges. Missing for 10: consistent hands-on evidence of reliable natural-language control across the whole app (not just the new Bionic feature), and resolution of reported agentic looping/UX issues.
